method: Whole-file manual reading of French catalog; v91 structural parity evidence retained; pinned source bytes reverified.
findings: Doublons probables, Préfixe de hachage and Hachage échantillonné explicitly preserve probability/prefix/sampling distinctions. Advanced option describes partial hashing above64Mio, consistent with reviewed sample threshold.

Recovery labels distinguish Récupérable and Peut-être récupérable; completed recovery still says verify file data. Same-volume restoration warns it can overwrite deleted data. These are product statements, not proof of recovery outcomes.
Unlike Russian/Ukrainian wording, sparsify is explicitly Rendre le fichier clairsemé and glob patterns remain modèles glob, preserving distinctions from compression and regular expressions.
Logical and physical size are distinct; a general size-display caption uses Go/Mo/Ko while explicit unit labels use GiB/MiB/KiB. Actual numerical unit presentation requires runtime inspection.
Deletion captions claim impossible recovery/undo; these describe permanent-delete UI intent, not secure erasure. No destructive command executed.

Cleanup placeholders %p/%n/%sp/%sn and brace fields are retained; line breaks in subdirectory-help label can affect rendered fit. MSI fr-FR/1036/1252 declarations alone do not prove installer encoding.
limits: No rendered layout, mnemonic collision or Windows installer validation. No foreign production code adopted.
